mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months with a decline in FEDFUNDS (relative to the prior month).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 2000) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months with rising INDPRO (month-over-month increase).

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales above 350,000 (RSAFS > 350000) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months when RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals a robust economy and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters with GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.
